2026-10-21 Volume Infusion

Lower-Body MEV Volume Injection

✓ IMPROVED
Trigger: Volume Starvation Guardrail (Quads 5.5 sets/wk vs 8.0 MEV threshold)
Physiological 'Why' Rationale: ATHX Games 2027 benchmark deficit is concentrated in the barbell back squat (-41.0 kg delta) and deadlift (-31.7 kg delta). With systemic ACWR safely in the adaptation corridor (0.84), the neuromuscular system possesses biological bandwidth to absorb a mandatory +4 to +6 weekly set lower-body stimulus without spiking injury hazard.
Pre-Intervention Baseline Quads 5.5 sets/wk · Lower Body MEV Deficit · Pre-HRV 28 ms
Post-Intervention Result Gym Session A executed (16 working sets) · Durability +15.5% · Garmin HRV surged to 76 ms
● Immediate volume absorption with zero gait asymmetry compensation.
2026-10-20 Active Recovery

Autonomic Protection & Active Deload Shift

✓ OPTIMIZED
Trigger: Morning Health Check (Garmin Overnight HRV plunged to 28 ms vs 52 ms baseline)
Physiological 'Why' Rationale: A steep overnight drop in Garmin HRV (28 ms, UNBALANCED) signals acute sympathetic dominance and blunted vagal reactivation. Executing high-glycolytic conditioning in this compromised state blunts muscle protein synthesis (mTOR) and degrades power output. Substituted high-intensity work with tissue recovery and restorative sleep.
Pre-Intervention Baseline Garmin Overnight HRV: 28 ms (Suppressed Vagal Tone) · ACWR 0.91
Post-Intervention Result Garmin Overnight HRV: 72 ms (+171% rebound) · Peak 109 ms · RHR 60 bpm
● Parasympathetic restoration achieved in 48h window.
2026-10-10 Threshold Architecture

Critical Speed (CS) Pacing Threshold Lock

✓ IMPROVED
Trigger: 5km Aerobic Pace Benchmark (+37s/km gap vs 4:30 ATHX qualification)
Physiological 'Why' Rationale: Running above Critical Speed (3.24 m/s / 5:09/km) drains the finite 63.3m D' battery, inducing metabolic acidosis and cellular fatigue that directly blunts subsequent heavy squat hypertrophic adaptation. Capping continuous aerobic running at CS allows mitochondrial biogenesis while isolating high-velocity sprint capacity to controlled 1k repeats.
Pre-Intervention Baseline Historical 5k Pace: 5:34/km · Anaerobic fatigue leakage
Post-Intervention Result 5k Pace accelerated to 5:07/km · Fastest 1k split 4:42/km · D' battery protected
● +27s/km velocity progression with zero systemic interference.
2026-10-16 Pacing Stabilization

CrossFit Work-Rate Pacing Stabilization

✓ IMPROVED
Trigger: Durability Fade Alert (66.6% late-round power loss in functional circuit)
Physiological 'Why' Rationale: Analysis of multi-set circuits revealed severe late-round volume blowout when tier 1 is opened at maximal anaerobic velocity. Enforced steady-state pacing at 85% effort across the initial 33% of working sets to protect power output across the final 33%.
Pre-Intervention Baseline Oct 16 Session: 66.6% volume fade · Durability score 30.0%
Post-Intervention Result Subsequent sessions: 0% to -15.5% fade · Composite Durability 89.3%
● Elite stamina restored with sustained round density.
